Ahmed Basil.note: Watch Fadhil for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ahmed Basil.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ahmed Maknzi.summary: Ahmed Maknzi is an Iraq left-back from Al-Karma who gives the national team wide defending, recovery runs, and defensive flexibility.
Ahmed Maknzi.note: Maknzi's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Ahmed Maknzi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Ahmed Qasem.note: Qasem is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ahmed Qasem.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Aimar Sher.note: Sher's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Aimar Sher.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Akam Hashim.note: Hashem stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Akam Hashim.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ali Al-Hamadi.summary: Ali Al-Hamadi is an Iraq centre-forward from Luton Town who gives the national team hold-up play, runs in behind, and penalty-box finishing.
Ali Al-Hamadi.note: Al-Hamadi's edge is making the next teammate's action easier. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ali Al-Hamadi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ali Jasim.note: Jasim is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ali Jasim.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ali Yousif.note: Yousif's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ali Yousif.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Amir Al-Ammari.summary: Amir Al-Ammari is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Cracovia who gives the national team screening, left-footed passing, and set-piece support.
Amir Al-Ammari.note: Al-Ammari stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Amir Al-Ammari.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Aymen Hussein.note: Watch Hussein for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Aymen Hussein.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Fahad Talib.note: Talib stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Fahad Talib.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Frans Putros.note: Watch Putros for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Frans Putros.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Hussein Ali.note: Ali is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Hussein Ali.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ibrahim Bayesh.note: Bayesh is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ibrahim Bayesh.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Jalal Hassan.note: Hassan is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jalal Hassan.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Kevin Yakob.note: Yakob's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Kevin Yakob.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Marko Farji.note: Farji is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Marko Farji.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Merchas Doski.note: Doski stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Merchas Doski.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Mohanad Ali.note: Ali's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Mohanad Ali.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Munaf Younus.note: Younis is defined by using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Munaf Younus.noteZh: 他靠在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mustafa Saadoon.summary: Mustafa Saadoon is an Iraq right-back from Al-Shorta who gives the national team wide defending, recovery speed, and overlap support.
Mustafa Saadoon.note: Saadoon is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mustafa Saadoon.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Rebin Sulaka.note: Watch Sulaka for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Rebin Sulaka.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Youssef Amyn.note: Watch Amyn for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Youssef Amyn.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Zaid Ismail.summary: Zaid Ismail is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Al-Talaba who gives the national team screening, duel work, and simple central passing.
Zaid Ismail.note: Ismail's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Zaid Ismail.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Zaid Tahseen.note: Tahseen's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Zaid Tahseen.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Zidane Iqbal.note: Watch Iqbal for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Zidane Iqbal.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
